ABOUT ECOCHARGE

Understand the project.
Know what you are looking at.

EcoCharge is an EV-charging participation concept presented under the ALT-INFRA brand. This site lets you explore the proposed client experience.

WHAT WE ARE BUILDING

One place to understand
your participation.

The concept brings station research, plan calculations, documents and manager conversations into a single account.

Drivers’ charging payments are the proposed business revenue source. The demo shows how a client could review a weekly allocation and track its history.

Read how the model works
